commuter.name: Commuter
commuter.blurb: The everyday small car: nothing fancy, and it gets there.

junker.name: Junker
junker.blurb: Dented but quick for its price, and tougher than a Commuter.

darkvan.name: Darkvan
darkvan.blurb: A panel van that keeps up and takes a lot of punishment.

postvan.name: Post Van
postvan.blurb: A sturdy post van, a little quicker than the starter cars.

keitruck.name: Kei Truck
keitruck.blurb: A tiny truck, nimble sideways and light on its feet.

mini.name: Mini
mini.blurb: Small, nimble and quick off the line: it slips through gaps.
mini.perk: Slips through gaps: scraping down the side of another car costs it nothing

lovebus.name: Love Bus
lovebus.blurb: A slow, roomy love bus that soaks up the knocks.

wagon.name: Family Wagon
wagon.blurb: A family wagon: steady, a little faster, and fairly tough.

sport.name: Sportscompact
sport.blurb: Fast and quick to accelerate for its tier, but fragile.

lowrider.name: Lowrider
lowrider.blurb: Low and steady: a good top speed in a sturdy frame.

hothatch.name: Hot Hatch
hothatch.blurb: A quick hatch, sharp in the steering.

ute.name: Ute
ute.blurb: A heavy ute: fast for its tier and hard to push around.

buggy.name: Beach Buggy
buggy.blurb: A beach buggy: fast, light and agile.

liftedtruck.name: Lifted Truck
liftedtruck.blurb: A lifted truck: heavy, tough and hard to shove aside.

hearse.name: Hearse
hearse.blurb: A hearse: fast for its price, and sturdy.

pickup.name: Pick-Up
pickup.blurb: A pick-up with a good turn of speed and plenty of health.

hotrod.name: Hot Rod
hotrod.blurb: A hot rod: very quick away, but not built to crash.

sleeper.name: Sleeper Wagon
sleeper.blurb: A sleeper wagon: quick and tough in one plain package.

rally.name: Rally Car
rally.blurb: A rally car: fast, agile, and unbothered by mud.
rally.perk: Ignores mud: no slower in it, and it steers as well as ever

towtruck.name: Tow Truck
towtruck.blurb: A tow truck: heavy and tough, and it shoves others aside.

rotary.name: Rotary Coupe
rotary.blurb: A rotary coupe: very quick and very sharp to steer.

taxi.name: Taxi
taxi.blurb: A taxi: quick and sturdy, built for the city.

suv.name: SUV
suv.blurb: An SUV: steady, with a very sturdy body.

miata.name: Sportscar
miata.blurb: A sportscar: fast and quick to accelerate, but lightly built.

gullwing.name: Stainless Gullwing
gullwing.blurb: A stainless gullwing: heavy, fast and very tough.

rearengine.name: Rear-Engine Coupe
rearengine.blurb: A rear-engine coupe: fast, sharp to steer and fairly tough.

snake.name: Snake Roadster
snake.blurb: A snake roadster: very quick off the mark.

polytruck.name: Polygon Truck
polytruck.blurb: A polygon truck: huge, heavy and tough, but slow to turn.

muscle.name: Muscle Car
muscle.blurb: A muscle car: fast and heavy, and it shoulders traffic aside.

fullsize.name: Full-Size
fullsize.blurb: A full-size sedan: very tough and very heavy.

evsaloon.name: EV Saloon
evsaloon.blurb: An EV saloon: the quickest off the line of the garage.

superlowrider.name: Super Lowrider
superlowrider.blurb: A super lowrider: fast, tough and steady.

classicgt.name: Classic GT
classicgt.blurb: The Classic GT: the fastest car in the garage, and agile.

sixbysix.name: 6x6
sixbysix.blurb: The 6x6: the toughest car there is, and it smashes rocks aside.
sixbysix.perk: Ignores rockfall: it smashes fallen rocks aside without a scratch

herald.name: Sailing Herald
herald.blurb: An amphibious sailing herald: small, light and nimble.
herald.perk: Amphibious: it drives into the water and floats across

floatvan.name: Float Van
floatvan.blurb: An amphibious float van: roomy, sturdy and heavy.
floatvan.perk: Amphibious: it drives into the water and floats across

toybota.name: Toybota
toybota.blurb: An amphibious Toybota: a good all-rounder that floats.
toybota.perk: Amphibious: it drives into the water and floats across

dampervan.name: Dampervan
dampervan.blurb: An amphibious dampervan: tough and heavy.
dampervan.perk: Amphibious: it drives into the water and floats across

nissank.name: Nissank
nissank.blurb: An amphibious Nissank: fast, heavy and tough.
nissank.perk: Amphibious: it drives into the water and floats across

tank.name: Tank
tank.blurb: A tank: in TANK RAGE from the start of every level.

ufo.name: UFO
ufo.blurb: A flying saucer: very fast and very nimble.

f1.name: F1 Car
f1.blurb: A Formula 1 car: very fast, light and nimble.

gt.name: GT Car
gt.blurb: A GT racer: fast, and tougher than an F1 car.

lmp.name: LMP Prototype
lmp.blurb: A Le Mans prototype: very fast, and the toughest racer.

jetboat.name: Jetboat
jetboat.blurb: A jetboat: nimble, bobbing across open water.

apc.name: 8x8
apc.blurb: An 8x8: heavy, slow to get going and tough.
